name: Heavy Metal
overview: Scripture encourages believers to find true strength and renewal not in worldly things but through waiting on the Lord and being transformed by the renewing of the mind. While the metaphor of heavy metal, such as iron sharpening iron, illustrates the refining and strengthening effect of godly fellowship, true rest and exaltation come from trusting in God alone. Praising God with heartfelt reverence and stillness acknowledges His sovereign power and exaltation above all, offering spiritual renewal and endurance beyond the burdens of life.
